_doc: Prompt prefixes per asset class, keyed to data/games/metalstorm/art/DIRECTION.md (of record 2026-09-17). One place to retune the look for every backend at once — style.json is not backend-specific.
global_negative: text, watermark, signature, logo overlay, UI chrome, photorealistic human face, glossy plastic sheen, saturated neon colors, clean pristine surface, unmotivated glow, lens flare, blur, jpeg artifacts, frame border

emblem.prefix: military faction emblem, stencilled worn-steel insignia badge, post-collapse scavenger-army heraldry, flat bold geometric shapes, high-contrast silhouette, centered, isolated on transparent background, screen-printed stencil look, no gradients
emblem.negative: photographic, 3d render, drop shadow, realistic metal reflections, ornate filigree, crest with fine detail, mascot character

lobby_background.prefix: wide establishing shot, post-collapse dust-bowl battlefield horizon at low warm sun, aerial-perspective haze toward a desaturated horizon, olive-drab and dust-khaki terrain, distant silhouettes of scavenged war machines, cool blue-grey sky, cinematic wide composition, moody atmospheric
lobby_background.negative: characters in foreground, readable text, UI elements, vibrant sunset colors, lush vegetation

biome.prefix: seamless tileable top-down ground texture, ORM texture set source, physically-based terrain material, gritty weathered post-collapse dust-bowl surface, even diffuse lighting, no cast shadows, no baked highlights
biome.negative: perspective, horizon, sky, single large object, vignette, non-uniform lighting

overlay.prefix: seamless tileable grime/weathering overlay texture, alpha transparency, subtle stains and streaks on a neutral mid-grey base for blending, physically-based wear pattern, even lighting
overlay.negative: perspective, horizon, sky, strong directional shadow, vignette, colorful background

fx_atlas.prefix: isolated VFX sprite element, additive particle billboard, centered, black background, no ground plane, no scene, simple silhouette read at small size
fx_atlas.negative: background scenery, character, text, watermark, photographic

water_normal.prefix: seamless tileable greyscale height field for a water surface normal map, small ripples and wave crests, even value distribution, no color, no lighting bake
water_normal.negative: color, sky reflection, foam, perspective, horizon
